GaussDB E2E Shenzhen audit {{RUN_ID}}
On 14 March 2026 in Shenzhen, Northstar Logistics supervisor Elena Brooks approved the Atlas-A17 sensor for the vaccine route.
The approved maximum transit temperature is 4 C because its calibration drift stayed below 0.2 C during the upstream cold-room trial.
This audit record belongs to {{RUN_ID}} and supersedes the older Helios review.
